description: The line plot illustrates the accuracy@1 (%) of two models, GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet, as a function of the number of child nodes (tree width), with the x-axis ranging from 1 to 7. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy@1 (%)", is scaled from 15 to 35. The GPT-4o model, represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, shows an increasing trend in accuracy from 24.4% at a tree width of 1 to a peak of 34.8% at a tree width of 5, followed by a decrease to 31.1% at a tree width of 7. The Claude-3.5-Sonnet model, represented by a dashed light blue line with star markers, exhibits a decreasing trend in accuracy from 26.7% at a tree width of 1 to 20.0% at a tree width of 7. At a tree width of 3, the accuracy for GPT-4o is 28.9% and for Claude-3.5-Sonnet is 27.8%. At a tree width of 5, the accuracy for GPT-4o is 34.8% and for Claude-3.5-Sonnet is 24.4%. The plot shows that GPT-4o achieves higher accuracy than Claude-3.5-Sonnet at all tested tree widths, with the largest difference occurring at a tree width of 5.
